title: feat: polyrouter - complexity/cost/health model router code agent
author: afanasevmylife
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

`polyrouter` - a code agent that routes each request to **the cheapest healthy model that fits the request's complexity**, then forwards the conversation unchanged. Callers see only the chosen model's answer.

- **Source repository:** https://github.com/afanasevmylife/polyrouter
- **Callable model:** `afanasevmylife/polyrouter` (registered, deployed at commit `973f149`, verified live)

## Design

1. **Classify (pure code)**: prompt length, code fences, reasoning keywords, conversation length, images, tools -> `fast` / `balanced` / `deep`. Classification spends no LLM call, so routing adds no extra model cost or latency.
2. **Live data**: `/v1/models?status=all` and `/v1/models/status?minutes=30` in parallel via `pollinations()` - pricing, capabilities, health, p95 latency, tokens/sec.
3. **Pick**: healthy text models meeting capability needs (image input, `tool_calling`; `deep` also requires `reasoning`), sorted by unit price with live p95 tiebreak - fast = cheapest, balanced = median-priced, deep = strongest. Empty band escalates upward. Per-model retries stay with the gateway (sequences, #14937); this agent only chooses *between* models.

## Outcome checklist

- [x] Works as a normal model - verified live through `POST /v1/responses` with `model: afanasevmylife/polyrouter`
- [x] Routing visible: `polyrouter_trace` body field (model, tier, reason, skip counts) + `x-polyrouter-*` headers
- [x] Three live requests routed differently, transcripts in `demos/`:
  - simple prompt -> `community/morriszdweck/osaii-swarm` (fast: cheapest healthy of 34)
  - code+reasoning prompt -> `community/pollinations-router/midijourney` (deep: strongest healthy reasoning model)
  - tool-calling request -> `meta/muse-glimmer-30b` (balanced: median-priced healthy tool_calling model)
- [x] `node --experimental-strip-types --test agent.test.ts` - 10/10 (classifier, capability/health filters, escalation, latency tiebreak, forwarding)

gist.headline: The cheapest bee for the job
gist.blurb: Polyrouter joined the garden as a code agent with a practical instinct: check what is healthy, check what the request needs, then send it to the right-priced brain. No extra LLM call required to decide who gets the difficult homework.
gist.summary: Added the live callable model `afanasevmylife/polyrouter`, a code agent that classifies requests as fast, balanced, or deep in pure code, reads live model pricing and 30-minute health data, and forwards the unchanged conversation to a healthy text model with the required capabilities.
gist.impact: Calls to `POST /v1/responses` using `afanasevmylife/polyrouter` now receive a selected model's normal answer, with `polyrouter_trace` plus `x-polyrouter-*` headers showing the chosen model, tier, reason, and skipped candidates.

Polli should look warmly analytical rather than dominant, wearing a tiny dispatcher headset and guiding a code-message envelope toward the best-fit terminal amid code-plants and flowers.
